title: Billa Chuha Chase
summary: One kitchen. Three teams. Bring your friends.
description: Play a five-minute Rat vs Cat vs Dog chase with up to 15 players across browser and Android. Join a lobby, choose your role and invite friends; bots fill empty spaces.

controls.label: Move & aim
controls.text: Hold WASD or arrow keys to move and use the mouse to aim. On touch screens, drag the joystick.

controls.label: Abilities
controls.text: Hold Space / E for ability 1 and Q for ability 2, or use the on-screen buttons. You can steer while using an ability.

title: Trap Escape
summary: Escape the Cat with falling ceilings, sliding floors and 19 cartoon traps.
description: Be the clever Rat in a manual chase platformer. The Cat follows your recorded route after a head start, slightly faster. Six carried items and thirteen stage traps include new ceiling slams, sliding floors, elevator launches, floor pistons, pendulum bonks, shutters and reversing conveyors. Pass their far levers to spring the machinery on the Cat, then chain its cartoon reactions. Ride or jump moving floors as you escape. Fifty stages span five worlds, with a boss chase in each. Quick retries, original mascots, optional sound and locally saved stars, times and progress keep every escape replayable. This is single player with an AI Cat.

controls.label: Run & jump
controls.text: A/D or Left/Right moves. W, Up or Space jumps. Touch uses a horizontal joystick and a separate Jump button. Movement starts the chase; P or Escape pauses.

controls.label: Set your traps
controls.text: Collect up to three trap items. E/F or DROP places the selected trap behind you. Q or Tab while the game canvas is focused cycles items. Tap inventory to select, tap again to drop, or swipe to cycle. Run beyond the far levers to arm ceiling slams, pistons, pendulums, shutters and other stage traps for the Cat. Sliding floors and elevators carry you and leave real gaps; conveyors move you in the arrow direction.

controls.label: Escape & chain
controls.text: Reach the door or land three Cat stuns. Hit again within three seconds for a combo. Boss chases require four stuns and a 2× chain. All nineteen trap types work with stun and combo scoring. Firecrackers have a two-second fuse; magnets pull nearby armed metal traps, including machinery, into the combo.

controls.label: Stars & progress
controls.text: Three stars for a Cat knockout, a 3× chain or beating par. Two for escaping with any stun; one for an escape. Clear each boss and earn 15 stars in its world to unlock the next. Best times, stars and retries save on this browser; no account is needed.

title: Kitchen Heist
summary: Sneak past Cat guards and Dog cameras to steal every last piece of cheese.
description: Sneak in. Grab the cheese. Get out alive. Control Rat through 50 top-down stealth stages across Home Kitchen, Restaurant, Factory, Warehouse and Secret Lab. Furniture blocks visible Cat vision cones; sprinting and metal floors make noise. Use moving cheese decoys, smoke bombs, one-use mouse tunnels and Soft Paws to outsmart patrols and hunting bosses. Dog cameras, conveyors, darkness and timed lasers change the route. Earn stars, improve best times and save progress locally. No account is needed.

controls.label: Sneak & sprint
controls.text: WASD or arrows move in eight directions. Hold Shift to sprint, or use the touch joystick and hold Sprint. Walking is quiet; sprinting and metal grates can attract nearby Cats. Choose keys and Customize HUD are available in the toolbar.

controls.label: Steal & escape
controls.text: Collect every cheese to unlock the exit. Yellow Cat cones and Dog spotlights stop at furniture and smoke. Cats pause in alert, chase after 1.5 seconds, then search after losing sight for three seconds. Camera beams and red lab lasers trigger a ten-second alarm. P / Escape pauses.

controls.label: Stealth tools
controls.text: Walk over glowing caches to carry up to three tools. E / Space or Use Tool activates the selected item; Q, Cycle or an inventory swipe cycles it. Decoy lures a patrol, Smoke blocks vision, Mouse Hole needs an entrance and exit 40–400px apart, and Soft Paws silences Rat for five seconds. Tap inventory slots to select.

controls.label: 50 jobs & hunter stages
controls.text: Every tenth job has a hunting Cat. Collect its two double-charge tools, distract the nearby hunter four times, take all cheese and escape. Three stars require no sightings and beating par; two require at most one sighting. Clear a boss and earn 15 stars to open the next world. Saves and best times remain in this browser; no online rankings are submitted.

title: Cat Chase
summary: Chase the Rat through 50 stages of falling ceilings and moving machinery.
description: Control the Cat in an original platform chase inspired by surprise-trap games. Run, jump and pounce after an AI Rat through 50 stages across five worlds. Thirteen trap families include wide ceiling slams, shifting ground, elevator floors, rising pistons, swinging wrecking balls, timed shutters and conveyors, alongside crumbling floors, spikes, falling crates, sliding walls, springs and fake exits. Different early hazards and combinations make each world’s chases varied. Catch the Rat, collect bonus bells and retry quickly. Stars, best times and stage unlocks save on this browser. Keyboard and separate touch controls support manual play.

controls.label: Move the Cat
controls.text: A/D or Left/Right moves. W, Up or Space jumps. Touch uses a horizontal joystick and separate Jump and Pounce buttons. Movement starts the chase. P or Escape pauses.

controls.label: Pounce & catch
controls.text: E/F or Shift pounces in the direction you face, with a 1.35-second cooldown. Catch the Rat by touching it. Pounce can extend a jump but cannot pass through walls or protect against traps. The AI Rat pauses at bait and waits briefly at its exit.

controls.label: Read the machinery
controls.text: Wait outside striped ceiling-slam zones, cross shutters while open and let floor pistons retract. Ride sliding/elevator floors, time the swinging wrecking ball, and follow conveyor arrows. Cracked floors, spikes, crates, walls, springs and fake exits return in varied combinations. Warnings mark each danger; failures retry automatically.

controls.label: 50 stages & local progress
controls.text: Catch the Rat to unlock the next stage. Three bonus bells, or beating par without a retry, earns three stars. Catch within two retries for two stars; every catch earns at least one. Replay cleared stages to improve stars and best times. This is single player with an AI Rat, and progress saves on this browser.

title: Long Survival
summary: Explore, collect cheese and jump past danger.
description: Take on a longer stage with cheese to collect and danger to avoid. Keep moving and time your jumps to keep the chase going.

controls.label: Move
controls.text: Use WASD / arrow keys or drag the joystick.

controls.label: Jump
controls.text: Press Space or the on-screen Jump button while steering.

title: Dungeon Dash
summary: Clear rooms, collect gems and come back stronger every run.
description: Jump & Fire has become Dungeon Dash: a solo roguelike platformer with fresh rooms, six enemy types, four weapons and endless floors. Clear enemies to unlock each exit, face a phased boss every tenth room and shop safely every five rooms. Keep unspent gems after death or retreat and buy seven permanent upgrades. Explore Kitchen, Garden, Rooftop, Sewer and Inferno themes with double jumps, auto-aim, combo rewards and optional player-reported deepest-room rankings. Progress saves locally on this device.

controls.label: Move & jump
controls.text: Use A/D or Left/Right to move, W/Up to jump twice, and S/Down to drop through platforms. Touch has a movement joystick and a separate Jump button. All movement and combat are manually controlled.

controls.label: Fire & equip
controls.text: Hold Space or FIRE to shoot with nearby-enemy auto-aim. F / SWAP or the weapon icon picks up a nearby weapon, otherwise swaps your two carried weapons. Pistol ammo is unlimited; SMG, shotgun and rocket ammo is limited. Rockets can hurt you up close.

controls.label: Rooms & bosses
controls.text: Defeat every enemy, then walk through the unlocked door on the right. Enemies and floors get harder as long as you survive. Every tenth room has a boss. Stomp enemies or shoot; attack shielded dogs from behind or above, and destroy the Dog General’s turret to break its shield.

controls.label: Gems & upgrades
controls.text: A safe shop every five rooms spends only your current-run gems. Unspent gems are banked when you die or retreat. Buy seven permanent upgrades between runs. P pauses; Retreat & keep gems safely ends the run. Progress stays on this browser, and online deepest-room scores are optional after signing in.

title: Sky Siege
summary: Climb an infinite tower while building traps to stop the Cats below.
description: A vertical platformer fused with tower defense. Jump upward as Rat through seeded shelves, collect cheese and leave Butter Traps, Magnet Mines, Firecrackers and friendly Dog Guards on passed platforms. Waves of Walkers, Jumpers, armored Tanks and hidden Ninjas climb after you every five layers. Kitchen, Garden, Rooftop, Sewer and Inferno themes mark your ascent. Earn milestone badges, bank unspent earned cheese and buy seven permanent upgrades between runs. Scores and upgrades save locally; no account is needed.

controls.label: Move & jump
controls.text: A/D or Left/Right moves. W, Up or Space jumps; release and tap again for a double jump. Touch has a joystick and a separate Jump button. Hold toward a world edge while falling to slide slowly. Choose keys and Customize HUD are available in the toolbar.

controls.label: Build below
controls.text: Q / Cycle or a swipe changes defense types. Tap a trap to select it. E / Place builds the selected defense on the shelf Rat stands on, spending cheese. Each shelf holds one defense; airborne placement is blocked. Butter costs 5, Magnet 10, Firecracker 15 and Dog Guard 25 before discounts.

controls.label: Hold off the Cats
controls.text: Every five layers brings a two-second wave warning. Walkers climb one shelf, Jumpers skip a layer, Tanks need two hits and Ninjas hide until nearby. Defend landing shelves, use blast/reveal tools and keep climbing. A Dog Guard lasts 20 seconds or three punches. Falling below the camera or Cat contact ends the run.

controls.label: Score & upgrades
controls.text: Score equals total earned cheese times highest layer reached. Unspent earned cheese banks on death, retreat or interrupted-run recovery. Buy seven permanent upgrades between runs. Packed-lunch starter cheese funds traps and cannot be banked. Milestone rewards are once per profile. Best scores and upgrades stay in this browser.

title: Moving Stairs: Snake & Ladder
summary: Roll the dice, leap through moving stairs and race to cell 100.
description: A 100-cell Snake & Ladder adventure where every dice roll becomes a playable platform challenge. Cross moving stairs, climb ladders, collect coins during snake falls and defeat cell guardians. Rat double-jumps and gains a bonus cell, Cat boosts and avoids its first snake, and Dog shoots and gets one reroll. Play solo against a ten-minute clock or pass the device between 2–4 friends. Explore Garden, House, Night and Volcano themes, earn three-turn powers and optionally save completed solo scores with your existing account. Online multiplayer is planned for a future phase.

controls.label: Roll & race
controls.text: Choose Solo or Pass & play, select Rat, Cat or Dog and roll the dice. Select Play this move to enter the stage. Reach its flag to advance; falling keeps your starting cell. Reach cell 100 to win without an exact roll.

controls.label: Move & use abilities
controls.text: A/D or Left/Right moves. W/Up/Space jumps; Rat can jump twice and wall-slide. E activates Cat speed or Dog shots; F also fires as Dog. Touch uses a movement joystick and separate Jump / ability buttons. Dog can reroll once before a stage; Cat ignores its first snake.

controls.label: Special cells
controls.text: Climb ladder stages for a shortcut. Steer through snake falls: each coin saves one cell. Shield, extra-jump and speed cells help for three turns. Defeat guardians by stomping or shooting to gain four cells; losing skips a turn. P pauses; Board opens the full map during challenges.

controls.label: Play with friends & save scores
controls.text: Pass & play supports 2–4 people on one device with a ready screen between turns. Solo has a ten-minute clock and saves your best locally. Completed solo wins can be submitted to the player-reported leaderboard after signing in. Online multiplayer is not part of this version.

title: Super Fighting Arena
summary: Fly, dash and unleash energy powers in aerial stick-warrior battles.
description: Choose Blaze, Shadow or Titan and take the fight to a 1400 by 800 sky arena. Fly, air dash, teleport, shield and chain four basic attacks with six energy powers, including charged beams and ground shockwaves. Fight a bot at four difficulty levels or a friend on the same device with independent keyboard and touch controls. Two round wins take the best-of-three match, with 90 seconds per round. Original procedural stick-warrior art, energy auras, beam clashes and optional sound bring each hit to life. Online 1v1 is planned for a later phase. The original sword arena remains at fight.html.

controls.label: Move, fly & dash
controls.text: P1 uses WASD; P2 uses arrows. Tap Up to jump, hold it to fly, Down fast-falls, and double-tapping a direction dashes for 20 energy. Land to recharge. Touch uses a movement stick with Up for flight and double taps for dash.

controls.label: Basic attacks & powers
controls.text: P1: F attacks, G is Special 1, H is Special 2. P2: L attacks, K is Special 1, J is Special 2. Attack alone punches; Up + Attack uppercuts, Down + Attack kicks on ground or slams in air. Tap Special 1 for a blast, hold for a charged beam, or combine with Up for Rising Dragon.

controls.label: Defend & escape
controls.text: Tap Special 2 to teleport behind the opponent, hold it for an energy shield, or use Down + Special 2 in the air for Ground Pound. Left Shift blocks for P1; Right Shift blocks for P2. After five incoming hits, teleport can escape stun if you have 25 energy. P / Escape pauses. Move list shows damage, costs and every input.

controls.label: Choose your match
controls.text: Solo offers Easy, Normal, Hard and Impossible bots. Local 2 Player shares one keyboard or independent touch controls on one device. Two round wins take the match; draws replay the round. Timeouts compare remaining health percentage. Blaze charges beams faster, Shadow has no teleport cooldown and Titan has more health and a wider Ground Pound. Online play is a later phase.

title: Zombie Horde
summary: Explore a large survival map or capture four zones with your squad.
description: Team up online as Rat, Cat and Dog. Choose Endless Survival to explore five supply areas across a 2400 by 1800 map, or Capture the Zone to cross a sprawling warehouse, crew mounted guns, defend checkpoints and defeat the extraction boss. Both missions include jumping, rechargeable jetpacks and character abilities. Three players share each run, with bots filling empty slots.

controls.label: Move & fire
controls.text: Move with WASD / arrows and aim with the mouse. Click or hold Space to fire. Touch uses a movement joystick, FIRE and nearby-enemy auto-aim.

controls.label: Abilities & supplies
controls.text: J jumps; hold Shift, V or JET to fly. Rat: E jump, Q decoy, C dash. Cat: E speed boost, Q hide, C pounce. Dog: E chain hook, Q bark. R reloads; F swaps weapons. Land to collect ammo, weapons and medkits. White first-aid stations heal nearby players.

controls.label: Capture the Zone
controls.text: Choose Capture the Zone in the game menu. Hold each marked ring for 20 seconds; zombies contest capture. T / USE TURRET crews a mounted gun; move or press T again to dismount. Secure four zones and defeat the final boss to extract.

controls.label: Play together
controls.text: Sign in with your existing Billa Chuha account. Use Quick Play or create a private room and share its invitation. One Rat, Cat and Dog; empty slots receive bots at start. Each mission has its own Quick Play queue.

title: Arena Blitz
summary: Fly, gear up and fight in online 3-vs-3 jetpack battles.
description: Join Alpha or Bravo as Rat, Cat or Dog in a six-player online arena. Explore a spacious 2400 by 1100 arena with wide platforms and spread-out team spawns. A following camera keeps players large, while the minimap shows both teams and weapon locations. Use a fuel-limited jetpack, collect weapons, throw grenades and race to 20 kills. Five-minute rounds, respawns and sudden death keep the battle moving. Bots fill empty slots.

controls.label: Move & fly
controls.text: A / D or arrows move. Space jumps; hold W / Up / Space to use the jetpack. S / Down drops through platforms. Touch uses the movement joystick and JET / JUMP. Your camera follows you; the arena minimap shows the whole stage, both teams and weapons.

controls.label: Fight & collect
controls.text: Aim with the mouse and click to fire; touch uses nearby-enemy auto-aim. Q / right click throws a grenade, E melees, R reloads and F / PICK UP swaps weapons.

controls.label: Win as a squad
controls.text: Each team has one Rat, Cat and Dog. First to 20 kills wins, or highest score after five minutes. Ties enter sudden death without respawns. Create rooms for friends or use Quick Play.
